chapter.verse: Mite in bangbang a geel zongin, Topa ’ deihna bang bekin a piang ding hi zaw hi.
Mihingte in a gamtatna uh-ah man kisa a, ahi zongin Topa in a khenna khat na om hi.
Na nasepnate khempeuh ah Topa ap in, tua hi leh na geelna bangin tangtung ding hi.
Topa in na khempeuh ngimna nei-in bawl a, migilote nangawn siatna thuak dingin a bawl ahi hi.
Topa in akihisak mite mudah a, daan a thuak hamtang nading uh, thei in.
Thumanna leh cihtakna in mawhmai ngahna hi a, Topa zahtakna in siatna tawh kipelhna hi.
Topa ’ deih bang-a gamtatna in, galte nangawn lawm-a kaih zawhna hi.
Thuman lo-a hauhna sangin, thuman-a tawmno neihna hoihzaw hi.
Mihing in thu geel a, ahi zongin Topa ’ deihna bangin kisemkhia hi.
Kumpipa in thuman gen a, thu a khen ciangin khial ngei lo ding hi.
A maan tawikhaina leh tawitehnate Topa ’ aa hi a, tawisuang khempeuh ama bawlsa ahi hi.
Thuman-a gamtatna bek in kumpi kipsak ahih manin, asia-a gamtat ding kumpite ut lo uh hi.
Kumpite in thuman genna deih uh a, thuman a gen mite it uh hi.
Kumpipa heh leh mi khatpeuh in sihlawh thei a, mipil khat in kumpipa lungdamsak thei hi.
Kumpipa maitaii leh nuntakna hi a, ama pahtakna in tuk-guah a zusak meiipi tawh kibang hi.
Kham sangin pilna hoihzaw a, ngun sangin thu theihna deihhuai zaw hi.
Mihoihte in siatna tawh a kipelh ding lampi tawn a, a lampi tot limtak-a a ngaihsun mi in a nuntakna a hu ahi hi.
Kisaktheihna in siatna hong tuak sak a, kiphatsakna in pukna hong piang sak hi.
Mi kihisak tawh kipawlin van kisutte ngahna sangin, mizawngte tawh kikhawlin mi neu-a om hoihzaw hi.
Thuhilhna a mang mite, a maa vang ding a, Topa a muang mite, thupha ngah ahi hi.
Lungsim pilte in thu muhna tawh kam pau uh a, amau’ kam khumna, zaknophuai kisa semsem hi.
Pilna in mipilte’ adingin hin’na tuinak bang hi a, mihaite ahih leh amau’ haina mah in daan thuak sak hi.
Mipilte in thu ngaihsun kawmin kam pau uh a, amau’ pauna zaknophuai semsem hi.
Kam khum in khuaipizu bang hi a, a kam-ah khum a, guh leh tangte adingin cidamna ahi hi.
Hoih hi, ci-a i ngaihsut khak thu khat pen, sih theih nading thu na hi thei zawsop hi.
An duhna in mi na semsak a, gilkialna in nak sepsak semsem zaw hi.
Migilote in siat nading bek zongzong a, a kampaunate uh na a kangtum thei meikuang tawh kibang hi.
Mihoih lote in kitotna piang sak a, mi gensiate in lawmta ki-it kimlai kimuhdah sak hi.
A ngongtat mite in a lawmte zol a, lungkhamna sung tun’pih hi.
A mit hong sitsante in thusia a ngaihsun hi a, a neh hong piksante in thusia geel ahi hi.
A teekte’ samkaang in minthan’na lukhu hi a, thuman-a nuntakna tawh a ngah ahi hi.
Vangliatna sangin lungduaina hoihzaw a, khuapi khat ukna sangin eima pumpi ki-uk zawhna hoihzaw hi.
Mite in bangbangin ai a san zongin, a piang ding thu in, Topa ’ deihna bang bek hizaw hi.
